summary: Tech-led weakness persists: S&P 500 and Nasdaq turned lower after a higher open with Nvidia sliding, though indexes still on track for weekly gains. Since 08:53: MSFT recovered to near flat despite the ongoing outage, so the MSFT put drops to 51; other picks unchanged (fresh quotes scarce).

picks.name: Palo Alto Networks
picks.reason: KeyBanc upgrade plus a security bid from the Microsoft outage; still holding gains but the weaker tape trims confidence slightly.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Pre-market bounce failed and shares are down ~2.5% under Thursday's 166.19 close on new affair allegations; under 160 extends, back over 166.2 the put is wrong.

picks.name: Cerebras Systems
picks.reason: Earnings beat, raised guide and Microsoft deal; gap still intact but AI names are fading with Nvidia, so a touch less confident.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Down ~2.6% giving back Thursday's rotation pop with the Nasdaq red; under 565 extends toward 553, over 581 the put is wrong.

picks.name: Microsoft
picks.reason: Outlook outage ongoing but shares have recovered to near flat (Microsoft says no malicious activity); under 505 still extends, reclaim of 521 kills the put.

picks.name: Cisco Systems
picks.reason: Selling the news on its FQ1 beat; under the 97.70 low extends toward 96, back over 100.8 the fade fails.
